result_text:
The parent landscape report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape has no readable `config.json`. The row still links to the sub-landscape's index page and shows the default landscape logo. The other rows and sub-landscapes with a config are unchanged.

**Change:** `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`, in `addSubLandscapeRow`. The NPE came from `subLandscapeConfig.getMetadata()` being dereferenced when `getSubLandscapeConfig` had returned `null`. The logo is now taken through a null check, so a missing config yields no logo and the existing `else` branch renders the default `landscape.png`. I also removed the `Metadata` import, which became unused.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl reports compile` succeeds and `mvn -o -pl reports test` passes (BUILD SUCCESS). The reports module has no test covering this section, so I did not reproduce the stale-link case end to end. Nothing was committed.
